headline: NTAKE debuts as virtual band with single 'MIRAGE'
sub: 4-member alt-rock band teases a first full album next
source: Source: Nomad Entertainment via Ilgan Sports, SPOTV News
caption:
Virtual band NTAKE has made its debut with first digital single 'MIRAGE.'

The 4-member band — Jeongo on drums, Jerock on bass, main vocalist Isaac and Eden on vocals and guitar — released the alternative rock track on Nov 18. 'MIRAGE' works as a prelude to the band's first full album, telling the story of four members in separate spaces who meet by following a single melody. NTAKE plans member-by-member content, follow-up songs and stages that mix live band sound with performance.
